authority: read-only; only current observed game snapshots allow instance generation

triState.unknown: withhold action, report blocker and request next relevant refresh

evaluationPolicy.tickPolling: not specified; do not evaluate all records every frame
evaluationPolicy.gameThread: all live game access stays on required game thread
evaluationPolicy.display: use cached results; not live predicate evaluation

records.description: Count only growing or regrowing crop tiles that benefit from water, are demonstrably dry, are not covered by effective rain and have no confirmed pending automated watering.
records.eligibility: crop.alive=true AND crop.needs-water=true AND crop.hydrated=false AND tile.rain-effective=false AND tile.automation-pending=false AND tile.reachable=true
records.quantityCalculation: COUNT DISTINCT (locationUniqueId,x,y) of eligible tiles (not total planted, not outside-sprinkler count)
records.completionCondition: All selected tiles are observed hydrated OR the task is invalidated by new verified rain/automation/harvest state; re-evaluate remaining count
records.unknownStateHandling: Any unobserved rain applicability, sprinkler action phase, hydration, growth phase or automation = UNKNOWN; never infer from sprinkler coverage alone.
records.status: data-contract-only; runtime integration and live validation pending

records.description: Harvest mature uncollected crops; do not double count delegated auto-harvesting.
records.quantityCalculation: COUNT DISTINCT harvestable crop tiles per crop and location; separately model variable per-tile output stacks
records.completionCondition: Selected crop tiles no longer have harvestable produce; reconcile re-growth and automatically harvested quantities
records.unknownStateHandling: If harvest readiness or automation disposition is unknown, defer manual instructions until confirmed; do not mark complete because Junimo hut exists.
records.status: data-contract-only; runtime integration and live validation pending

records.description: Feed only animals with unmet daily food needs after checking valid grazed grass, troughs and autofeeders.
records.quantityCalculation: COUNT DISTINCT hungry animal IDs; hay-to-place = MIN(eligible animals, empty usable trough slots, unreserved hay), report shortage separately
records.completionCondition: Observed per-animal feed satisfied (grazed or trough/autofeeder consumption when effective); do not treat placing hay alone as proof animal ate
records.unknownStateHandling: Unknown animal grazing or autofeeder phase makes individual need uncertain; show an investigation/blocked task instead of purchasing hay by assumption.
records.status: data-contract-only; runtime integration and live validation pending

records.description: Collect ready animal output on ground, from animals or auto-grabbers without double counting.
records.quantityCalculation: SUM observed collectible output stacks grouped by item+location+collection method, deduplicated by producer/output ID
records.completionCondition: Each selected product removed from world/animal/auto-grabber into selected accessible storage; remaining stack decrements
records.unknownStateHandling: Unknown ready state, grabber contents or duplicate ownership = block/deduplicate; never infer produced quantity from animal count.
records.status: data-contract-only; runtime integration and live validation pending

records.description: Empty observed ready outputs from placed machines, including stack counts and location.
records.quantityCalculation: SUM ready output stacks (or count machines if quantities unknown); include machine tile IDs
records.completionCondition: Output removed from each selected machine or collector; reconcile quantity and item identity after change
records.unknownStateHandling: Held output, completion timer or automation ownership unknown = unknown; do not predict collection from elapsed time alone.
records.status: data-contract-only; runtime integration and live validation pending

records.description: Load idle accessible machines only where a valid input-to-target transformation and unreserved ingredients are known.
records.eligibility: machine.idle=true AND input-rule.verified=true AND demand.positive=true AND stock.unreserved>=required-input-quantity AND machine.access=true
records.quantityCalculation: MIN(number of eligible idle machines, FLOOR(unreserved-stock / per-machine-input), outstanding-output-demand) per machine+input recipe; allocate resources without double-booking
records.completionCondition: Selected machines observed processing matching inputs, and consumption reservations reconciled; task may be skipped by explicit no-demand choice
records.unknownStateHandling: If machine data or recipe-output identity is unavailable, emit no speculative replenishment, retain explicit unknown demand.
records.status: data-contract-only; runtime integration and live validation pending

records.description: Warn when an actionable crop/fish/seasonal objective could expire before next viable opportunity.
records.quantityCalculation: COUNT distinct at-risk item/goal/window tuples; list exact days or UNKNOWN when maturity cannot be calculated
records.completionCondition: Achievement objective satisfied OR valid alternate window confirmed OR seasonal window elapsed with outcome explicitly recorded
records.unknownStateHandling: Unverified weather, season exceptions, soil state, speed modifier or alternate route = uncertainty interval; issue conditional warning, never deterministic expiry.
records.status: data-contract-only; runtime integration and live validation pending

records.description: Suggest legal high-value birthday gifts and optional daily friendship interactions to relevant NPCs.
records.eligibility: npc.giftable=true AND npc.birthday-today-or-enabled-social-task=true AND no-birthday-gift-given=true AND available-positive-taste-gift=true
records.quantityCalculation: COUNT NPCs with eligible interaction; one birthday gift target per NPC, not number of candidate gifts; optional talk count separate
records.completionCondition: Birthday gift observed in player/NPC gift counters or equivalent durable daily state; optional talk observed separately
records.unknownStateHandling: Unverified birthday, tastes or gift eligibility blocks suggestion. If NPC schedule cannot be confirmed, show opportunity but no fabricated location.
records.status: data-contract-only; runtime integration and live validation pending

records.description: List presently reachable outstanding fish only when water, season, clock, weather, rod and special requirements intersect.
records.eligibility: fish.outstanding=true AND fish.spawn-route-resolved=true AND location.accessible=true AND in-time-window=true AND season-compatible=true AND weather-compatible=true AND spot-and-gear-compatible=true
records.quantityCalculation: COUNT DISTINCT eligible fish IDs by fishing spot and current window; one task per fish objective, not estimated catches
records.completionCondition: Caught-history for target species increases to required goal OR current window ends and task is explicitly expired/deferred; reevaluate after each catch
records.unknownStateHandling: Missing location spawn or opaque content condition = UNKNOWN; never promote Data/Fish alone to an eligible fishing route.
records.status: data-contract-only; runtime integration and live validation pending
